body: Reviewed. The interactive plot canvas (exam.html graph questions) already exceeds this spec: tabindex=0, role=application, aria-label, Arrow keys for cursor movement, Enter to place/remove points, aria-live announcements for each action. For the read-only Chart.js SVG chart in index.html: that's already an SVG with role=img and aria-label (not a canvas element). No further action needed. WCAG 2.1.1 satisfied. Marking sw-18 closed.
subject: ACK: sw-18 graph keyboard -- existing implementation exceeds spec
